import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- All targets in range
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

def WeightedGraph.path_has_weight (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (w_total : Int) : Prop :=
  match p with
  | [] => w_total = 0
  | [_] => w_total = 0
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      ∃ w_edge w_rest,
        g.has_edge u v w_edge ∧
        g.path_has_weight (v :: rest) w_rest ∧
        w_total = w_edge + w_rest

def WeightedGraph.is_path (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  match p with
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | u :: v :: rest =>
      (∃ w, g.has_edge u v w) ∧ g.is_path (v :: rest)

-- Shortest path predicate
def WeightedGraph.is_shortest_dist (g : WeightedGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ g.path_has_weight p d) ∧
  (∀ p w, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → g.path_has_weight p w → w >= d)

-- Negative cycle predicate
def WeightedGraph.has_negative_cycle (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p w, g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast? ∧ g.path_has_weight p w ∧ w < 0

def WeightedGraph.weights_and_size_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  start < graph.size ∧
  graph.weights_and_size_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Tentative distances: integers extended with `+∞` (`⊤`, meaning "not reached yet"). -/
abbrev BFDist := WithTop Int

/-- Convert a tentative distance into the reported `Option Int`. -/
def wtToOpt (x : BFDist) : Option Int :=
  if h : x = ⊤ then none else some (WithTop.untop x h)

/-- All incoming edges of `v`, as `(source, weight)` pairs. -/
def WeightedGraph.edgesTo (g : WeightedGraph) (v : Nat) : List (Nat × Int) :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap fun u =>
    ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.filter (fun p => p.1 == v)).map (fun p => (u, p.2))

/-- One Bellman-Ford relaxation of every incoming edge of `v`. -/
def WeightedGraph.relaxAt (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Nat → BFDist) (v : Nat) : BFDist :=
  (g.edgesTo v).foldl (fun acc p => min acc (d p.1 + (p.2 : BFDist))) (d v)

/-- One full relaxation round over all vertices. -/
def bfStep (g : WeightedGraph) (prev : List BFDist) : List BFDist :=
  (List.range g.size).map (fun v => g.relaxAt (fun u => prev.getD u ⊤) v)

/-- The distance layer after `k` relaxation rounds, materialised once per round. -/
def bfLayer (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) : Nat → List BFDist
  | 0 => (List.range g.size).map (fun v => if v = s then (0 : BFDist) else ⊤)
  | k + 1 => bfStep g (bfLayer g s k)

/-- Lookup in the `k`-th layer. -/
def bfGet (g : WeightedGraph) (s k v : Nat) : BFDist := (bfLayer g s k).getD v ⊤

/-- Final `|V|`-th verification pass: no improvement ⇒ report distances, else `none`. -/
def bfFinish (g : WeightedGraph) (D : Nat → BFDist) : Option (List (Option Int)) :=
  if _h : ∀ v ∈ List.range g.size, g.relaxAt D v = D v then
    some ((List.range g.size).map (fun v => wtToOpt (D v)))
  else
    none
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bellman_ford (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Option (List (Option Int)) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let L := bfLayer graph start (graph.size - 1)
  bfFinish graph (fun v => L.getD v ⊤)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bellman_ford_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (result : Option (List (Option Int)))
    (_ : bellman_ford_precond graph start) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dists =>
      dists.length = graph.size ∧
      ∀ v, v < graph.size →
        match dists.getD v none with
        | some d => graph.is_shortest_dist start v d
        | none => ¬ ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some v
  | none =>
      graph.has_negative_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

theorem wtToOpt_top : wtToOpt ⊤ = none := by simp [wtToOpt]

theorem wtToOpt_coe (d : Int) : wtToOpt (d : BFDist) = some d := by simp [wtToOpt]

theorem getD_map_range {α : Type} (f : Nat → α) (n v : Nat) (dflt : α) :
    ((List.range n).map f).getD v dflt = if v < n then f v else dflt := by
  have hlen : ((List.range n).map f).length = n := by simp
  by_cases h : v < n
  · have h1 : v < ((List.range n).map f).length := by omega
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1]
    simp [h]
  · have h2 : ((List.range n).map f)[v]? = none := by
      apply List.getElem?_eq_none; omega
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, h2]
    simp [h]

section FoldMin
variable {α : Type}

theorem foldMin_le_init (f : α → BFDist) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (a : BFDist), l.foldl (fun acc x => min acc (f x)) a ≤ a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons y t ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    exact le_trans (ih (min a (f y))) (min_le_left _ _)

theorem foldMin_le_mem (f : α → BFDist) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (a : BFDist) (x : α), x ∈ l →
      l.foldl (fun acc y => min acc (f y)) a ≤ f x := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a x hx; simp at hx
  | cons y t ih =>
    intro a x hx
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
    · exact le_trans (foldMin_le_init f t (min a (f x))) (min_le_right _ _)
    · exact ih _ _ hx'

theorem foldMin_cases (f : α → BFDist) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (a : BFDist),
      l.foldl (fun acc y => min acc (f y)) a = a ∨
      ∃ x ∈ l, l.foldl (fun acc y => min acc (f y)) a = f x := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; left; simp
  | cons y t ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases ih (min a (f y)) with h | ⟨x, hx, h⟩
    · rw [h]
      rcases min_cases a (f y) with ⟨h1, _⟩ | ⟨h1, _⟩
      · left; exact h1
      · right; exact ⟨y, by simp, h1⟩
    · right; exact ⟨x, by simp [hx], h⟩

end FoldMin

theorem mem_edgesTo (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) :
    (u, w) ∈ g.edgesTo v ↔ g.has_edge u v w := by
  simp only [WeightedGraph.edgesTo, WeightedGraph.has_edge, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map,
    List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Array.mem_toList, beq_iff_eq, Prod.mk.injEq]
  aesop

theorem edge_target_lt (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) {u v : Nat} {w : Int}
    (h : g.has_edge u v w) : v < g.size := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pair, hp, h1, _⟩ := h
  have := (hwf u hu).1 pair hp
  exact h1 ▸ this

theorem edgesTo_eq_nil (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (v : Nat)
    (hv : ¬ v < g.size) : g.edgesTo v = [] := by
  rw [List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rintro ⟨u, w⟩ hmem
  exact hv (edge_target_lt g hwf ((mem_edgesTo g u v w).mp hmem))

theorem relaxAt_le_self (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Nat → BFDist) (v : Nat) :
    g.relaxAt d v ≤ d v := foldMin_le_init _ _ _

theorem relaxAt_le_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Nat → BFDist) (v u : Nat) (w : Int)
    (h : g.has_edge u v w) : g.relaxAt d v ≤ d u + (w : BFDist) :=
  foldMin_le_mem (fun p => d p.1 + (p.2 : BFDist)) _ _ (u, w) ((mem_edgesTo g u v w).mpr h)

theorem relaxAt_cases (g : WeightedGraph) (d : Nat → BFDist) (v : Nat) :
    g.relaxAt d v = d v ∨
    ∃ q ∈ g.edgesTo v, g.relaxAt d v = d q.1 + (q.2 : BFDist) :=
  foldMin_cases _ _ _

theorem bfGet_zero (g : WeightedGraph) (s v : Nat) :
    bfGet g s 0 v = if v < g.size then (if v = s then (0 : BFDist) else ⊤) else ⊤ := by
  simp only [bfGet, bfLayer]
  rw [getD_map_range]

theorem bfGet_of_ge (g : WeightedGraph) (s k v : Nat) (hv : ¬ v < g.size) :
    bfGet g s k v = ⊤ := by
  cases k <;> simp [bfGet, bfLayer, bfStep, getD_map_range, hv]

theorem bfGet_succ (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) (k v : Nat) :
    bfGet g s (k + 1) v = g.relaxAt (bfGet g s k) v := by
  by_cases hv : v < g.size
  · have h : bfGet g s (k + 1) v = g.relaxAt (fun u => (bfLayer g s k).getD u ⊤) v := by
      simp only [bfGet, bfLayer, bfStep]
      rw [getD_map_range, if_pos hv]
    rw [h]
    rfl
  · rw [bfGet_of_ge g s (k + 1) v hv, WeightedGraph.relaxAt, edgesTo_eq_nil g hwf v hv]
    simp [bfGet_of_ge g s k v hv]

theorem bfGet_anti (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (j m v : Nat), bfGet g s (j + m) v ≤ bfGet g s j v := by
  intro j m
  induction m with
  | zero => intro v; exact le_refl _
  | succ m ih =>
    intro v
    have h1 : bfGet g s (j + (m + 1)) v ≤ bfGet g s (j + m) v := by
      rw [show j + (m + 1) = (j + m) + 1 from rfl, bfGet_succ g s hwf]
      exact relaxAt_le_self _ _ _
    exact le_trans h1 (ih v)

/-! ### List helpers -/

theorem getLast_decomp : ∀ (p : List Nat) (v : Nat), p.getLast? = some v → ∃ p', p = p' ++ [v] := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro v h; simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro v h
    cases t with
    | nil => simp at h; exact ⟨[], by simp [h]⟩
    | cons b t2 =>
      have h2 : (b :: t2).getLast? = some v := by simpa using h
      obtain ⟨p', hp'⟩ := ih v h2
      exact ⟨a :: p', by simp [hp']⟩

theorem getLast?_app : ∀ (L1 L2 : List Nat), L2 ≠ [] → (L1 ++ L2).getLast? = L2.getLast? := by
  intro L1
  induction L1 with
  | nil => intro L2 _; simp
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro L2 h
    have h2 : t ++ L2 ≠ [] := by
      cases L2 with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl h
      | cons c d => simp
    cases hc : (t ++ L2) with
    | nil => exact absurd hc h2
    | cons b r =>
      have hstep : (a :: (t ++ L2)).getLast? = (t ++ L2).getLast? := by rw [hc]; simp
      rw [List.cons_append, hstep]
      exact ih L2 h

theorem mem_decomp : ∀ (l : List Nat) (x : Nat), x ∈ l → ∃ A B, l = A ++ x :: B := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro x hx; simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
    · exact ⟨[], t, by simp⟩
    · obtain ⟨A, B, hAB⟩ := ih x hx'
      exact ⟨a :: A, B, by simp [hAB]⟩

theorem not_nodup_decomp : ∀ (l : List Nat), ¬ l.Nodup →
    ∃ A x B C, l = A ++ x :: (B ++ x :: C) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd List.nodup_nil h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro h
    by_cases ha : a ∈ t
    · obtain ⟨B, C, hBC⟩ := mem_decomp t a ha
      exact ⟨[], a, B, C, by simp [hBC]⟩
    · have ht : ¬ t.Nodup := by
        intro hc
        exact h (List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨ha, hc⟩)
      obtain ⟨A, x, B, C, hd⟩ := ih ht
      exact ⟨a :: A, x, B, C, by simp [hd]⟩

theorem not_nodup_of_len (l : List Nat) (n : Nat) (hlt : ∀ x ∈ l, x < n)
    (hlen : n < l.length) : ¬ l.Nodup := by
  intro hnd
  have h1 : l.toFinset.card = l.length := by
    rw [List.card_toFinset, hnd.dedup]
  have h2 : l.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_range]
    exact hlt x hx
  have h3 := Finset.card_le_card h2
  rw [h1, Finset.card_range] at h3
  omega

/-! ### Path algebra -/

theorem is_path_cons2 (g : WeightedGraph) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    g.is_path (a :: b :: t) ↔ (∃ w, g.has_edge a b w) ∧ g.is_path (b :: t) := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.is_path]

theorem is_path_pos (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) (h : g.is_path p) : p.length > 0 := by
  unfold WeightedGraph.is_path at h
  exact h.1

theorem is_path_single (g : WeightedGraph) (a : Nat) : g.is_path [a] := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.is_path]

theorem pw_single (g : WeightedGraph) (a : Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight [a] w ↔ w = 0 := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

theorem pw_cons2 (g : WeightedGraph) (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) (w : Int) :
    g.path_has_weight (a :: b :: t) w ↔
      ∃ we wr, g.has_edge a b we ∧ g.path_has_weight (b :: t) wr ∧ w = we + wr := by
  simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]

theorem exists_weight (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat), g.is_path p → ∃ w, g.path_has_weight p w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _; exact ⟨0, by simp [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight]⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro hp
    cases t with
    | nil => exact ⟨0, (pw_single g a 0).mpr rfl⟩
    | cons b t2 =>
      obtain ⟨⟨we, he⟩, hrest⟩ := (is_path_cons2 g a b t2).mp hp
      obtain ⟨wr, hwr⟩ := ih hrest
      exact ⟨we + wr, (pw_cons2 g a b t2 _).mpr ⟨we, wr, he, hwr, rfl⟩⟩

theorem path_mem_lt (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (t : List Nat) (a : Nat), g.is_path (a :: t) → a < g.size → ∀ x ∈ a :: t, x < g.size := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | nil => intro a _ ha x hx; simp at hx; omega
  | cons b t2 ih =>
    intro a hp ha x hx
    obtain ⟨⟨we, he⟩, hrest⟩ := (is_path_cons2 g a b t2).mp hp
    have hb : b < g.size := edge_target_lt g hwf he
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
    · exact ha
    · exact ih b hrest hb x hx'

theorem snoc (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (u v : Nat) (we w0 : Int), p.getLast? = some u →
      g.has_edge u v we → g.is_path p → g.path_has_weight p w0 →
      g.is_path (p ++ [v]) ∧ g.path_has_weight (p ++ [v]) (w0 + we) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u v we w0 h; simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro u v we w0 hlast hedge hpath hw
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      simp at hlast
      subst hlast
      have hw0 : w0 = 0 := (pw_single g a w0).mp hw
      subst hw0
      constructor
      · rw [List.singleton_append]
        exact (is_path_cons2 g a v []).mpr ⟨⟨we, hedge⟩, is_path_single g v⟩
      · rw [List.singleton_append]
        exact (pw_cons2 g a v [] _).mpr ⟨we, 0, hedge, (pw_single g v 0).mpr rfl, by ring⟩
    | cons b t2 =>
      have hlast' : (b :: t2).getLast? = some u := by simpa using hlast
      obtain ⟨⟨e, he⟩, hrest⟩ := (is_path_cons2 g a b t2).mp hpath
      obtain ⟨e', r, he', hr, hweq⟩ := (pw_cons2 g a b t2 w0).mp hw
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih u v we r hlast' hedge hrest hr
      constructor
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append]
        refine (is_path_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ [v])).mpr ⟨⟨e', he'⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa using ih1
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append]
        refine (pw_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ [v]) _).mpr ⟨e', r + we, he', ?_, by rw [hweq]; ring⟩
        simpa using ih2

theorem unsnoc (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (v : Nat) (w : Int), p ≠ [] →
      g.is_path (p ++ [v]) → g.path_has_weight (p ++ [v]) w →
      ∃ u we w0, p.getLast? = some u ∧ g.has_edge u v we ∧ g.is_path p ∧
        g.path_has_weight p w0 ∧ w = w0 + we := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro v w h; exact absurd rfl h
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro v w _ hpath hw
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      rw [List.singleton_append] at hpath hw
      obtain ⟨we, r, he, hr, hweq⟩ := (pw_cons2 g a v [] w).mp hw
      have hr0 : r = 0 := (pw_single g v r).mp hr
      exact ⟨a, we, 0, by simp, he, is_path_single g a, (pw_single g a 0).mpr rfl,
        by rw [hweq, hr0]; ring⟩
    | cons b t2 =>
      rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append] at hpath hw
      obtain ⟨⟨e, he⟩, hrest⟩ := (is_path_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ [v])).mp hpath
      obtain ⟨e', r, he', hr, hweq⟩ := (pw_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ [v]) w).mp hw
      have hrest' : g.is_path ((b :: t2) ++ [v]) := by simpa using hrest
      have hr' : g.path_has_weight ((b :: t2) ++ [v]) r := by simpa using hr
      obtain ⟨u, we, r0, hlast, hedge, hp2, hw2, hreq⟩ :=
        ih v r (by simp) hrest' hr'
      refine ⟨u, we, e' + r0, by simpa using hlast, hedge,
        (is_path_cons2 g a b t2).mpr ⟨⟨e', he'⟩, hp2⟩,
        (pw_cons2 g a b t2 _).mpr ⟨e', r0, he', hw2, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [hweq, hreq]; ring

theorem split_at (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (l1 : List Nat) (x : Nat) (l2 : List Nat) (w : Int),
      g.is_path (l1 ++ x :: l2) → g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ x :: l2) w →
      ∃ w1 w2, g.is_path (l1 ++ [x]) ∧ g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ [x]) w1 ∧
        g.is_path (x :: l2) ∧ g.path_has_weight (x :: l2) w2 ∧ w = w1 + w2 := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil =>
    intro x l2 w hp hw
    rw [List.nil_append] at hp hw
    exact ⟨0, w, by simpa using is_path_single g x, by simpa using (pw_single g x 0).mpr rfl,
      hp, hw, by ring⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x l2 w hp hw
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      rw [List.singleton_append] at hp hw
      obtain ⟨⟨e, he⟩, hrest⟩ := (is_path_cons2 g a x l2).mp hp
      obtain ⟨e', r, he', hr, hweq⟩ := (pw_cons2 g a x l2 w).mp hw
      refine ⟨e', r, ?_, ?_, hrest, hr, hweq⟩
      · rw [List.singleton_append]
        exact (is_path_cons2 g a x []).mpr ⟨⟨e', he'⟩, is_path_single g x⟩
      · rw [List.singleton_append]
        exact (pw_cons2 g a x [] _).mpr ⟨e', 0, he', (pw_single g x 0).mpr rfl, by ring⟩
    | cons b t2 =>
      rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append] at hp hw
      obtain ⟨⟨e, he⟩, hrest⟩ := (is_path_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ x :: l2)).mp hp
      obtain ⟨e', r, he', hr, hweq⟩ := (pw_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ x :: l2) w).mp hw
      have hrest' : g.is_path ((b :: t2) ++ x :: l2) := by simpa using hrest
      have hr' : g.path_has_weight ((b :: t2) ++ x :: l2) r := by simpa using hr
      obtain ⟨w1, w2, hi1, hi2, hi3, hi4, hi5⟩ := ih x l2 r hrest' hr'
      refine ⟨e' + w1, w2, ?_, ?_, hi3, hi4, by rw [hweq, hi5]; ring⟩
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append]
        refine (is_path_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ [x])).mpr ⟨⟨e', he'⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa using hi1
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append]
        refine (pw_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ [x]) _).mpr ⟨e', w1, he', ?_, rfl⟩
        simpa using hi2

theorem merge_at (g : WeightedGraph) :
    ∀ (l1 : List Nat) (x : Nat) (l2 : List Nat) (w1 w2 : Int),
      g.is_path (l1 ++ [x]) → g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ [x]) w1 →
      g.is_path (x :: l2) → g.path_has_weight (x :: l2) w2 →
      g.is_path (l1 ++ x :: l2) ∧ g.path_has_weight (l1 ++ x :: l2) (w1 + w2) := by
  intro l1
  induction l1 with
  | nil =>
    intro x l2 w1 w2 _ h1 h3 h4
    have : w1 = 0 := by simpa using (pw_single g x w1).mp (by simpa using h1)
    subst this
    exact ⟨by simpa using h3, by simpa using h4⟩
  | cons a t ih =>
    intro x l2 w1 w2 hp1 hw1 hp2 hw2
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      rw [List.singleton_append] at hp1 hw1
      obtain ⟨⟨e, he⟩, _⟩ := (is_path_cons2 g a x []).mp hp1
      obtain ⟨e', r, he', hr, hweq⟩ := (pw_cons2 g a x [] w1).mp hw1
      have hr0 : r = 0 := (pw_single g x r).mp hr
      constructor
      · rw [List.singleton_append]
        exact (is_path_cons2 g a x l2).mpr ⟨⟨e', he'⟩, hp2⟩
      · rw [List.singleton_append]
        exact (pw_cons2 g a x l2 _).mpr ⟨e', w2, he', hw2, by rw [hweq, hr0]; ring⟩
    | cons b t2 =>
      rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append] at hp1 hw1
      obtain ⟨⟨e, he⟩, hrest⟩ := (is_path_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ [x])).mp hp1
      obtain ⟨e', r, he', hr, hweq⟩ := (pw_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ [x]) w1).mp hw1
      have hrest' : g.is_path ((b :: t2) ++ [x]) := by simpa using hrest
      have hr' : g.path_has_weight ((b :: t2) ++ [x]) r := by simpa using hr
      obtain ⟨hi1, hi2⟩ := ih x l2 r w2 hrest' hr' hp2 hw2
      constructor
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append]
        refine (is_path_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ x :: l2)).mpr ⟨⟨e', he'⟩, ?_⟩
        simpa using hi1
      · rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append]
        refine (pw_cons2 g a b (t2 ++ x :: l2) _).mpr ⟨e', r + w2, he', ?_, by rw [hweq]; ring⟩

/-! ### The two Bellman-Ford invariants -/

theorem wt_add_le_add_right {a b : BFDist} {c : Int} (h : a ≤ b) :
    a + (c : BFDist) ≤ b + (c : BFDist) := by
  rcases eq_or_ne b ⊤ with rfl | hb
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hb
    have ha : a ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro hc; rw [hc, top_le_iff] at h; exact absurd h (WithTop.coe_ne_top)
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp ha
    rw [← WithTop.coe_add, ← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_le_coe]
    have := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp h
    omega

/-- Relaxation invariant: after `k` rounds, no walk of at most `k` edges beats `bfGet k`. -/
theorem bf_le (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hs : s < g.size) :
    ∀ (k : Nat) (p : List Nat) (w : Int) (v : Nat), g.is_path p → p.head? = some s →
      p.getLast? = some v → g.path_has_weight p w → p.length ≤ k + 1 →
      bfGet g s k v ≤ (w : BFDist) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro p w v hp hh hl hw hlen
    have hpos : p.length > 0 := is_path_pos g p hp
    have h1 : p.length = 1 := by omega
    match p, h1 with
    | [a], _ =>
      simp at hh hl
      subst hh
      have hw0 : w = 0 := (pw_single g a w).mp hw
      subst hl
      rw [bfGet_zero]
      simp [hs, hw0]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro p w v hp hh hl hw hlen
    by_cases hsmall : p.length ≤ k + 1
    · have h1 : bfGet g s (k + 1) v ≤ bfGet g s k v := by
        rw [bfGet_succ g s hwf]; exact relaxAt_le_self _ _ _
      exact le_trans h1 (ih p w v hp hh hl hw hsmall)
    · obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ := getLast_decomp p v hl
      have hlenp : p'.length = k + 1 := by simp at hlen hsmall; omega
      have hp'ne : p' ≠ [] := by
        intro hc; rw [hc] at hlenp; simp at hlenp
      obtain ⟨u, we, w0, hlu, hedge, hpp', hww0, hweq⟩ := unsnoc g p' v w hp'ne hp hw
      have hhead' : p'.head? = some s := by
        cases p' with
        | nil => exact absurd rfl hp'ne
        | cons a t => simpa using hh
      have h1 := ih p' w0 u hpp' hhead' hlu hww0 (by omega)
      have h2 : bfGet g s (k + 1) v ≤ bfGet g s k u + (we : BFDist) := by
        rw [bfGet_succ g s hwf]; exact relaxAt_le_edge g _ v u we hedge
      have h3 : bfGet g s k u + (we : BFDist) ≤ ((w0 : BFDist)) + (we : BFDist) :=
        wt_add_le_add_right h1
      have h4 : ((w0 : BFDist)) + (we : BFDist) = (w : BFDist) := by
        rw [← WithTop.coe_add, hweq]
      rw [← h4]
      exact le_trans h2 h3

/-- Achievability: every finite layer value is realised by an actual walk. -/
theorem bf_ex (g : WeightedGraph) (s : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat) (d : Int), bfGet g s k v = (d : BFDist) →
      ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some s ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧
        g.path_has_weight p d ∧ p.length ≤ k + 1 := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v d hd
    rw [bfGet_zero] at hd
    by_cases hv : v < g.size
    · rw [if_pos hv] at hd
      by_cases hvs : v = s
      · rw [if_pos hvs] at hd
        subst hvs
        have hd0 : d = 0 := by
          have : ((0 : Int) : BFDist) = (d : BFDist) := by simpa using hd
          exact (WithTop.coe_eq_coe.mp this).symm
        subst hd0
        exact ⟨[v], is_path_single g v, by simp, by simp, (pw_single g v 0).mpr rfl, by simp⟩
      · rw [if_neg hvs] at hd; exact absurd hd.symm (WithTop.coe_ne_top)
    · rw [if_neg hv] at hd; exact absurd hd.symm (WithTop.coe_ne_top)
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v d hd
    rw [bfGet_succ g s hwf] at hd
    rcases relaxAt_cases g (bfGet g s k) v with h | ⟨⟨u, we⟩, hmem, h⟩
    · rw [h] at hd
      obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ih v d hd
      exact ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4, by omega⟩
    · rw [h] at hd
      simp only at hd
      have hne : bfGet g s k u ≠ ⊤ := by
        intro hc; rw [hc] at hd; simp at hd
      obtain ⟨d0, hd0⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hne
      rw [← hd0, ← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_eq_coe] at hd
      obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := ih u d0 hd0.symm
      have hpne : p ≠ [] := by
        intro hc; rw [hc] at h1; simp [WeightedGraph.is_path] at h1
      have hlast : p.getLast? = some u := h3
      have hedge : g.has_edge u v we := (mem_edgesTo g u v we).mp hmem
      obtain ⟨hs1, hs2⟩ := snoc g p u v we d0 hlast hedge h1 h4
      refine ⟨p ++ [v], hs1, ?_, by simp, by rw [← hd]; exact hs2, by simp; omega⟩
      cases p with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl hpne
      | cons a t => simpa using h2

theorem bellman_ford_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : bellman_ford_precond graph start) :
    bellman_ford_postcond graph start
      (bellman_ford graph start h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hs, _hb⟩ := h_precond
  have hbf : bellman_ford graph start ⟨hwf, hs, _hb⟩
      = bfFinish graph (bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1)) := rfl
  rw [hbf]
  simp only [bfFinish]
  split_ifs with hchk
  · -- No improvement in the |V|-th pass: report the distances.
    simp only [bellman_ford_postcond]
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    have hfix : ∀ u, graph.relaxAt (bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1)) u
        = bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1) u := by
      intro u
      by_cases hu : u < graph.size
      · exact hchk u (List.mem_range.mpr hu)
      · rw [WeightedGraph.relaxAt, edgesTo_eq_nil graph hwf u hu]; simp
    have hstep : ∀ m u, bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1 + m) u
        = bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1) u := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => intro u; rfl
      | succ m ih =>
        intro u
        rw [show graph.size - 1 + (m + 1) = (graph.size - 1 + m) + 1 from rfl,
          bfGet_succ graph start hwf]
        have hfe : bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1 + m)
            = bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1) := funext ih
        rw [hfe]; exact hfix u
    have hDmin : ∀ k u, bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1) u ≤ bfGet graph start k u := by
      intro k u
      by_cases hk : k ≤ graph.size - 1
      · have h := bfGet_anti graph start hwf k (graph.size - 1 - k) u
        rwa [show k + (graph.size - 1 - k) = graph.size - 1 from by omega] at h
      · have hk2 : k = graph.size - 1 + (k - (graph.size - 1)) := by omega
        rw [hk2, hstep]
    rw [getD_map_range, if_pos hv]
    rcases eq_or_ne (bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1) v) ⊤ with hT | hT
    · rw [hT, wtToOpt_top]
      rintro ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_weight graph p hp
      have hpos : p.length > 0 := is_path_pos graph p hp
      have hle := bf_le graph start hwf hs (p.length - 1) p w v hp hh hl hw (by omega)
      have := le_trans (hDmin (p.length - 1) v) hle
      rw [hT, top_le_iff] at this
      exact WithTop.coe_ne_top this
    · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hT
      rw [← hd, wtToOpt_coe]
      constructor
      · obtain ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4, _⟩ :=
          bf_ex graph start hwf (graph.size - 1) v d hd.symm
        exact ⟨p, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
      · intro p w hp hh hl hw
        have hpos : p.length > 0 := is_path_pos graph p hp
        have hle := bf_le graph start hwf hs (p.length - 1) p w v hp hh hl hw (by omega)
        have h2 := le_trans (hDmin (p.length - 1) v) hle
        rw [← hd, WithTop.coe_le_coe] at h2
        omega
  · -- Improvement in the |V|-th pass: extract an explicit negative cycle.
    simp only [bellman_ford_postcond]
    push_neg at hchk
    obtain ⟨v, hvmem, hvne⟩ := hchk
    rw [List.mem_range] at hvmem
    have hsz : graph.size - 1 + 1 = graph.size := by omega
    have hlt : bfGet graph start graph.size v < bfGet graph start (graph.size - 1) v := by
      rw [← hsz, bfGet_succ graph start hwf]
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (relaxAt_le_self _ _ _) hvne
    have hne : bfGet graph start graph.size v ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_lt hlt
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hne
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, hw, hlen⟩ :=
      bf_ex graph start hwf graph.size v d hd.symm
    -- The realising walk must have exactly |V|+1 vertices.
    have hbig : graph.size < p.length := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have := bf_le graph start hwf hs (graph.size - 1) p d v hp hh hl hw (by omega)
      rw [hd] at this
      exact absurd hlt (not_lt.mpr this)
    -- All vertices of the walk lie in range, so one repeats.
    have hmem : ∀ x ∈ p, x < graph.size := by
      cases p with
      | nil => intro x hx; simp at hx
      | cons a t =>
        have ha : a = start := by simpa using hh
        subst ha
        exact path_mem_lt graph hwf t a hp hs
    obtain ⟨A, x, B, C, hdec⟩ :=
      not_nodup_decomp p (not_nodup_of_len p graph.size hmem hbig)
    subst hdec
    obtain ⟨w1, w2, hA1, hA2, hR1, hR2, hweq1⟩ := split_at graph A x (B ++ x :: C) d hp hw
    have hR1' : graph.is_path ((x :: B) ++ x :: C) := by simpa using hR1
    have hR2' : graph.path_has_weight ((x :: B) ++ x :: C) w2 := by simpa using hR2
    obtain ⟨wc, w3, hC1, hC2, hT1, hT2, hweq2⟩ := split_at graph (x :: B) x C w2 hR1' hR2'
    obtain ⟨hM1, hM2⟩ := merge_at graph A x C w1 w3 hA1 hA2 hT1 hT2
    -- The shortened walk still reaches `v` with at most |V|-1 edges.
    have hlenr : (A ++ x :: C).length ≤ graph.size := by
      simp at hlen ⊢
      omega
    have hheadr : (A ++ x :: C).head? = some start := by
      cases A with
      | nil => simpa using hh
      | cons a t => simpa using hh
    have hlastr : (A ++ x :: C).getLast? = some v := by
      rw [getLast?_app A (x :: C) (by simp)]
      have h1 : A ++ x :: (B ++ x :: C) = (A ++ x :: B) ++ (x :: C) := by simp
      rw [h1, getLast?_app (A ++ x :: B) (x :: C) (by simp)] at hl
      exact hl
    have hbound := bf_le graph start hwf hs (graph.size - 1) (A ++ x :: C) (w1 + w3) v
      hM1 hheadr hlastr hM2 (by omega)
    rw [← hd] at hlt
    have hfinal : (d : BFDist) < ((w1 + w3 : Int) : BFDist) := lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hbound
    rw [WithTop.coe_lt_coe] at hfinal
    -- Hence the extracted cycle has negative weight.
    refine ⟨(x :: B) ++ [x], wc, hC1, by simp, ?_, hC2, by omega⟩
    rw [getLast?_app (x :: B) [x] (by simp)]
    simp
  -- !benchmark @end proof
